summary.text: Berlin-based Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 10+ years of experience building and operating production software, with deep experience in e-commerce, Shopify, APIs, integrations, and customer-facing products. At Curalife, owned major parts of the Shopify-based commerce and digital-health ecosystem, including customer journeys, Shopify-HubSpot integrations, frontend modernization, cloud infrastructure, and a HIPAA-compliant telemedicine acquisition product that became one of the company’s primary customer-acquisition and revenue funnels. Strong across React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and cloud systems, with end-to-end ownership from architecture and implementation through deployment and iteration.
summary.metaDescription: Berlin-based Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 10+ years of experience across e-commerce, Shopify, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, APIs, integrations, and cloud systems.

cartshift.title: Founder & Senior Full-Stack Engineer
cartshift.description: Independent full-stack and e-commerce engineering practice combining client delivery with hands-on development of production web, commerce, and AI-assisted products.
highlights: Build and ship full-stack products and client systems using Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, APIs, PostgreSQL, and modern cloud tooling.
Deliver e-commerce and Shopify-focused work spanning storefront development, integrations, performance optimization, conversion-oriented improvements, and workflow automation.
Created products including StarLinker and RightFlow, owning product definition, architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration.

curalife.title: Full Stack Developer & R&D Lead
curalife.description: Owned major customer-facing product and platform work across Shopify commerce and digital health, spanning storefronts, acquisition funnels, frontend, backend, integrations, cloud infrastructure, and production operations.
highlights: Owned the technical evolution of Curalife’s Shopify-based e-commerce ecosystem, building and improving customer journeys, storefront experiences, Shopify-HubSpot integrations, and supporting operational workflows.
Designed a resilient Shopify-HubSpot integration layer that reduced sync failures by 85%, improving reliability between commerce, CRM, and internal operations.
Led frontend modernization across key commerce and acquisition journeys, improving page performance by 60% while moving core experiences to Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
Defined, architected, and built Curalife’s HIPAA-compliant telemedicine acquisition product end-to-end; it became one of the company’s primary customer-acquisition and revenue funnels.
